name: Chase Colton
source:
Chase is a new senior student at Riley's school. He is seen as a bashful and courteous person. He blushes a lot when talking to people.
His last name "Colton" is as in Colton the Pharmaceutical company. He transferred from a private school called "Ildis Academy". He has a bodyguard named Kayden.
He usually calls Riley by her full name. 
Chase can be found in the computer labs.
